title: Import
description: Bring a WordPress site over: its posts, pages, media, comments, menus and redirects. An import can run again; items edited here since are kept.

start.label: New import

wxr.title: WordPress export
wxr.hint: The .xml file from Tools → Export in WordPress (all content), up to 512 MiB.

uploads.title: Uploads folder
uploads.hint: A .zip of wp-content/uploads, up to 4 GiB. Without it, media is only imported when fetched from the old site.

start.dryRunHint: Run every step, then roll every change back: a report without touching the site.
start.keepPermalinksHint: Take the old site's post URL structure, so old links keep working.
start.siteOptionsHint: Replace this site's title and tagline with the old site's.
start.fetchMediaHint: Download attachments the zip does not have from the old site.
start.categoryBaseHint: The old site's category base, for redirects (Settings → Permalinks in WordPress).
start.tagBaseHint: The old site's tag base, for redirects.
start.badBase: Letters, digits, - _ . ~ and slashes between segments, at most {{max}} characters.

errors.network: The upload stopped: no answer from the server. Retry sends the same files again without starting a second import.
errors.reply: The server took the files but its answer could not be read. Retry to see the import.
errors.server: The server could not start the import. Retry sends the same request again without starting a second import.
errors.busy: Another import is queued or running. Wait for it to finish, then start again.
errors.inProgress: This upload is still being received. Retry in a few seconds.
errors.inProgressWait: This upload is still being received. Trying again in a moment…

run.label: Current import

phaseBody.queued: The files are in. A node picks the import up within moments.
phaseBody.running: You can leave this page; the import runs in the background.
phaseBody.retrying: An attempt failed (attempt {{attempts}} of 3). The import starts again shortly and resumes where it stopped.
phaseBody.done: Everything ran. The report lists what needs a look.
phaseBody.doneDry: Every step ran and every change was rolled back. The report shows what an import would do.
phaseBody.failed: The import stopped. Run the same export again to resume where it stopped.

run.stalled: No activity for over two minutes: the node running it may have stopped. Another node takes it over on the next attempt.
run.noReport: No report was written for this run.
run.notFound: This import job no longer exists.

runs.title: Previous imports
runs.label: Import runs
runs.htmlOn: Open the report of the import from {{source}} (opens in a new tab)
runs.jsonOn: Download the JSON report of the import from {{source}}

empty.title: No imports yet
empty.body: Imports started here or with ferrite import wordpress show up here, each with its report.
